uds.text: Gatha, one of Urza's geneticists, boasted that the academy educates while he employs, and he defected, using his knowledge to improve the Keldon race.
He experimented with splicing Phyrexian DNA into test subjects and was expelled, continuing his work in Keld, where he increased his subjects' stature but not their lifespans.
When Kreig seized power in Keld with Gatha at his side, Croag started a war to retrieve the research, and Gatha and Kreig jumped off a cliff to keep their knowledge from Phyrexia.
When Gatha fell, he was called to account for each abomination he had created.
